typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Agency NPN} as string,
		{Agency Name} as string,
		{Agent NPN} as string,
		{Agent Employee Number} as string,
		{Agent Status} as string,
		name_last as string,
		name_first as string,
		name_middle as string,
		{State License Abbreviation} as string,
		{State Name} as string,
		{State License Number} as string,
		{License Update Date} as string,
		{Original License Issue Date} as string,
		{License Expire Date} as string,
		{License Class Code} as string,
		{License Class Description} as string,
		{Residency Status} as string,
		{Active [License Status]} as string,
		{Record Create Date} as string,
		{Record Modify Date} as string,
		{agent location number} as string,
		{agent location name} as string,
		{Agent State License Status} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: true,
	wildcardPaths:['ALMS/alms_*_license_*']) ~> License
source(output(
		{Agent NPN} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: true,
	wildcardPaths:['ALMS/kaiser_agent.csv']) ~> KaiserAgent
DerivedColumn1 filter(upper({Active [License Status]})=='YES') ~> Filter1
Join1 select(mapColumn(
		Agency_NPN__c = {Agency NPN},
		Agency_Name__c = {Agency Name},
		Agent_NPN__c = License@{Agent NPN},
		Agent_Employee_Number__c = {Agent Employee Number},
		Agent_Status__c = {Agent Status},
		name_last__c = name_last,
		name_first__c = name_first,
		name_middle__c = name_middle,
		State_License_Abbreviation__c = {State License Abbreviation},
		State_Name__c = {State Name},
		State_License_Number__c = {State License Number},
		License_Update_Date__c = {License Update Date},
		Original_License_Issue_Date__c = {Original License Issue Date},
		License_Expire_Date__c = expire_date,
		License_Class_Code__c = {License Class Code},
		License_Class_Description__c = {License Class Description},
		Residency_Status__c = {Residency Status},
		Active_License_Status__c = {Active [License Status]},
		Record_Create_Date__c = {Record Create Date},
		Record_Modify_Date__c = {Record Modify Date},
		agent_location_number__c = {agent location number},
		agent_location_name__c = {agent location name},
		Agent_State_License_Status__c = {Agent State License Status}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
License derive(expire_date = toString(toDate({License Expire Date}), 'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss')) ~> DerivedColumn1
Filter1, KaiserAgent join(License@{Agent NPN} == KaiserAgent@{Agent NPN},
	joinType:'inner',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'auto')~> Join1
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[(concat('alms_license_', toString(currentUTC(), 'yyyyMMdd'), '.csv'))],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sink1
